obligations.expected_behavior: FAQ entries are optional; validation succeeds when no FAQ entry is supplied.
forbidden_result: Validation requires at least one FAQ entry.
Validation fails solely because no FAQ entry is supplied.
obligations.observable_result: A configuration with zero FAQ entries passes validation.
obligations.state_after: The FAQ set is accepted without requiring any entry.
obligations.subject: FAQ collection
obligations.trigger: Validation is run with no supplied FAQ entries.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each supplied FAQ entry is reachable from a declared stable error ID or decision branch.
forbidden_result: A supplied FAQ entry is orphaned from all declared stable error IDs and decision branches.
obligations.observable_result: Every supplied FAQ entry has a declared stable error ID or decision branch that reaches it.
obligations.state_after: All supplied FAQ entries have a valid declared reachability source.
obligations.state_before: FAQ entries may be supplied with or without declared reachability sources.
obligations.subject: Supplied FAQ entries
obligations.trigger: FAQ validation examines each supplied entry.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each supplied FAQ entry resolves to a local target.
forbidden_result: A supplied FAQ entry points to a dead or unresolvable local target.
obligations.observable_result: Local target resolution succeeds for every supplied FAQ entry.
obligations.state_after: All supplied FAQ targets are locally resolvable.
obligations.state_before: FAQ entries may reference local targets whose resolution has not yet been verified.
obligations.subject: FAQ local targets
obligations.trigger: FAQ validation resolves the local target for each supplied entry.

obligations.expected_behavior: Validation fails when a supplied FAQ entry is orphaned from any declared stable error ID or decision branch.
forbidden_result: An orphan FAQ entry is accepted as valid.
obligations.observable_result: The validator reports failure for each orphan FAQ entry.
obligations.state_after: The orphan FAQ entry is rejected.
obligations.state_before: A supplied FAQ entry has no declared stable error ID or decision branch reaching it.
obligations.subject: Orphan FAQ entry validation
obligations.trigger: Validation encounters a supplied FAQ entry with no declared stable error ID or decision branch.

obligations.expected_behavior: Validation fails when a supplied FAQ entry has a dead or unresolvable local target.
forbidden_result: A FAQ entry with a dead local target is accepted as valid.
obligations.observable_result: The validator reports failure for the dead-target FAQ entry.
obligations.state_after: The dead-target FAQ entry is rejected.
obligations.state_before: A supplied FAQ entry points to a local target that cannot be resolved.
obligations.subject: Dead FAQ target validation
obligations.trigger: Validation detects that a supplied FAQ entry's local target cannot be resolved.

obligations.expected_behavior: Validation fails when a supplied FAQ entry references an unknown error ID or decision branch.
forbidden_result: A FAQ entry referencing an undeclared error ID or decision branch is accepted as valid.
obligations.observable_result: The validator reports failure for the unknown-reference FAQ entry.
obligations.state_after: The unknown-reference FAQ entry is rejected.
obligations.state_before: A supplied FAQ entry references an error ID or decision branch that is not declared.
obligations.subject: Unknown FAQ error-or-branch validation
obligations.trigger: Validation encounters a supplied FAQ entry whose referenced error ID or decision branch is undeclared.
